scope.kind: model-free production-operator controls and short CPU microbenchmarks
scope.performance_claim_scope: Only the explicit tensor geometries, backend, thread counts and measured samples in this file.
scope.full_model_results: migan-cpu-2026-11-01.json records MI-GAN separately; LaMa and latent original-model qualification is not established by this record.

provenance.binding_limit: Each measurement preserves its recorded executable digest and observed source-file digests. These are not an attested clean-commit-to-binary build binding; different series used different working-tree builds.
provenance.sanitization: Removed absolute host paths. Executables use basenames; source keys are repository-relative. Benchmark JSON numbers and sample arrays were copied without recomputation.

measurement_method.warm_compute_includes: builder.compute() with an allocated persistent graph and already uploaded inputs
measurement_method.reference_timing_note: Reference durations include wrapper allocations and copies; speed ratios in the guide compare graph variants only.
measurement_method.rss_field_semantics: max_rss_kib is Linux resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss observed by each recorder after the child: a cumulative child-process maximum within that series, not a per-case isolated peak.
measurement_method.short_sample_warning: The portable GLA sweep has one warmup and two measured samples; native GLA and the later paired FFT experiment have two warmups and five samples. This is a bounded experiment, not a confidence interval or a full-model throughput estimate.

baseline_history.cause: Uploaded-once inputs and immutable index/weight initializers were marked INPUT without OUTPUT. The pinned graph allocator reused their storage after last use, corrupting persistent replay.
baseline_history.correction: Retain persistent parameters, integer constants and prepared transpose-convolution weights as INPUT and OUTPUT. Snapshot actual input/constant bytes in replay controls.
baseline_history.performance_baseline: All benchmark series below use the corrected portable graph. No speed ratio uses the original failed graph.
